payload.name: Isolated Git Worktree Lifecycle Hardening
payload.description: Isolate flow stages and ledger mutations in dedicated git worktrees with explicit ref and HEAD verification, non-destructive branch creation, checkpoint preservation, and deterministic teardown.

steps: Create each stage or ledger worktree from an explicitly verified ref rather than relying on the ambient working tree HEAD (sandbox_executor/git.py, sandbox_executor/flow/ledger_worktree.py).
Verify resolved branch refs and worktree cleanliness before committing or promoting artifacts so detached or stale HEAD states fail closed.
Record resumable stage checkpoints without destructive resets or force-pushes (sandbox_executor/flow/worktree_checkpoints.py).
Tear down temporary worktrees and prune stale administrative metadata in finally blocks even when a stage exits with an error.

known_pitfalls: Assuming the host checkout branch matches the target execution branch causes cross-branch file leakage.
Leaving orphaned worktree entries in .git/worktrees blocks subsequent branch checkouts on the same ref.
Running destructive git reset or clean commands outside the isolated worktree can discard operator changes.
